corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward damages the artillery. Melantha initially absorbs its eastern shell; Ansel preserves the later upper caster recipient. Resolve born projectiles after withdrawal or source death.
Midnight clears roadblock#3; Steward later clears#1. Record officer damage and every civilian-targeted shell rather than assuming operator bait overrides neutral promotion.
Melantha clears roadblock#4 before the lower civilian's eastern exposure and later clears#2. Ordinary operators never block or attack the civilian.

Fang supplies actual upper-central BLOCK. Friston and Midnight assist only while their own blocked queues permit. Returning Steward must clear armor and release capacity; two occupied slots are a hard limit.
Friston supplies actual lower-central BLOCK under lower Ansel. Midnight's available arts and returning Steward must remove armor before a third lower enemy reaches the holder.
Midnight remains the upper-outer blocker and roadblock attacker. His own blocked enemies interrupt central assistance.
Melantha remains the lower-outer blocker through the final officer, using attack skills to shorten one-block occupancy. Hibiscus must preserve her through the opening shell and subsequent duels.
